characters.name: luca
characters.prompt: Create a DISTINCT standalone hand-overlay PNG for the adult student character luca. Reference image is ONLY the exact gesture, camera, composition and pixel-art style guide, not a skin-color guide. Character-specific design: light golden-tan skin, warm golden highlights, compact broad palms, short natural square-rounded nails, subtle knuckles. Both hands of the SAME person, exactly matching skin tone on left and right. Redraw as that character's own hands, with unique finger proportions, creases, nails and shading, not just a color filter. Preserve the first-person heart-shaped viewing frame: index fingertips meet at x50%,y34%; thumb tips meet at x50%,y67%; transparent opening centered x50%,y51.5%, clear area roughly x29-71%,y36-63%. Same arms entering left/right edges, same full wide 1774x887 canvas and scale. For female design preserve the approved softer contours and visible manicured nails. For male design no polish. No sleeves, jewellery, watch, text, red reference dot or extra fingers. Blocky pixel-painted game art with restrained palette and clean dark outlines, not photorealistic. Skin colors must be painted into the PNG itself, opaque pixels inside the hands, never rely on transparency to achieve skin color. Genuine alpha transparency outside hands and inside viewing hole; no checkerboard or scenery. No crop or reposition.
